ar-SA.name: جرّبه قبل رحلتك

fi.name: Kokeile ennen matkaa
fi.shortDescription: Valitse kohde ja harjoittele oppaan kanssa.
fi.longDescription: Psybeam 1.1.1 lisää kohteen valinnan ja ohjatun harjoituksen, jotta olet valmis ennen vieraan kanssa käyttöä.

sv.name: Testa innan din resa
sv.shortDescription: Välj resmål och öva med en guide.
sv.longDescription: Psybeam 1.1.1 lägger till val av resmål och en guidad övning, så att du är redo innan du använder den på en främling.

cardBrief: A traveler holds up a phone with a soft glowing screen to a smiling street-food vendor under warm string lights at dusk (LTX-2.5 frame, no text: Apple renders the event name over the card). Files: marketing/appstore/events/art/event-card-1920x1080.png and event-details-1080x1920.png.
rationale: 1.1.1 adds a first-launch destination picker and a practice-hold coach, the two changes most likely to fix the funnel's real failure (78% of wallets never complete a translation, and the home-GPS en-to-en bug made the app look broken before anyone left the house) — so MAJOR_UPDATE is truthful and ATTRACT_NEW_USERS matches the constraint (32 downloads in 3 months, 0% search rank). The deep link psybeam://try (registered in 1.1.1) replays the destination picker and coach.
